name: Spiced Mulled Apple Cider

ingredients.name: cardamom pods, pressed until they just crack open

instructions.primary_message: Turn slow cooker to high and add apple cider. Cover and set aside.

Heat a small skillet on medium-high and add spices. Toast, stirring frequently, until spices are fragrant and coriander seeds begin to darken. Set aside and either transfer to a reusable spice bag or add loose to cider.

Cover and let cider mull on high (reduce if it begins to bubble) for about 4 hours, or until spice flavor is well infused. Ten minutes before serving, add brandy. Add sugar, 1 rounded teaspoon at a time, if cider is too tart (sugar will bring out flavor of spices if needed).
Serve plain, or with a slice of lemon, extra brandy, or a small grating of nutmeg. If keeping warm for service, remove spices.

schema_metadata.keywords: apple cider, cider, drink, fall, hot drink, mulled cider, winter

description: There's more to good mulled apple cider than swirling in a couple sticks of cinnamon.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Optional additions (see notes): 1 tablespoon brandy, raw sugar, lemon zest; Extra brandy, lemon slices, and/or freshly grated nutmeg, for serving (optional)

Notes: Ciders can vary greatly in sweetness and acidity. Adjust the final seasoning of the mulled cider with a spoonful of alcohol to enhance the fruity aromas, raw sugar to bring out the spice, and/or lemon to balance the sweetness. We recommend cider-friendly liquors, such as brandy, bourbon, or dark rum.
author: Max Falkowitz
